reels.title: Omni-Embed-Mini: Binding Modalities Without Forgetting via Dense Distillation

editorial_notes.reasoning: This paper (multimodal_diffusion category, 1.38x multiplier) is highly optimized for YouTube algorithms. It tackles the fascinating technical paradox of how to cram massive amounts of multimodal knowledge into a tiny model without it 'forgetting' past information.
editorial_notes.recommended_hook: What if you could shrink a brain to 1/10th its size without losing any of its memories?
editorial_notes.suggested_everyday_analogy: A 'magic suitcase' where you use hyper-efficient, space-saving vacuum seals to pack an entire closet's worth of clothes into a tiny carry-on without wrinkling them.
